title: Report Windows disks, make PDF page operations work without external tools, and stabilize Windows captures.
changes: Report Windows disk and volumes in get_system_info using native filesystem statistics instead of returning null/empty.
Merge, split and extract PDF pages with the built-in PDF engine when qpdf, pdftk or poppler are not installed; report the page count on info.
Serialize Windows full-screen captures and clean up GDI failures so screenshot calls do not block the relay.
Allow five seconds for the Windows integrity probe on heavily loaded hosts; preserve the 0.2.218 clipboard and replacement fixes.
